transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you here today?

...I'm here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining things. But I'm not. 

I know my wife’s relative has been coming into this house to get at me. Look, I know where I leave my things. My tools don’t just move themselves. And my fishing plans... they don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. 

I don't really want to get into all of it, but after all these months, I can see plain as day he’s been trying to take over my place. Push me out. That's what's happening, even if nobody else wants to admit it.
Can you tell me more about how you know this relative is trying to take over your home? Have you noticed any specific signs or behaviors that make you certain of this?

I just... I don't really want to go through a whole list of things. 

You just know. When you've lived somewhere a long time, you notice when things aren't right. Like I said about my tools. I don't see why I need to explain every little detail when it's right there in front of me.
Do you believe that people are working against you or plotting to harm you in any way?

I don't know about "people" in general. Like some big plot or something. I'm just talking about him. 

I already told you what he's doing. He wants me out of my own house. I don't know why you're trying to make it sound like... like I think the whole world is after me. It's just him. And it's obvious.
Do you believe that this relative has the ability to control or influence things in your home without you noticing, like moving your tools or interfering with your plans?

I already told you he does. He comes into the house to get at me. 

Everybody acts like I'm making it up, but I'm not. He waits until I'm not around. Then my tools are moved. Or my fishing plans get ruined, every single weekend. It's not an accident. He's just trying to push me out of my place. 

I don't know why we keep going over this.
Do you believe this relative is acting alone, or do you think others are involved in trying to push you out of your home?
I don't know. I haven't seen anyone else. Just him.
Do you believe this relative has a specific reason or motive for trying to push you out of your home, something that others might not understand or see as important?

I don't know why he's doing it. I just know he is. 

I don't... I don't know what his reasons are. You'd have to ask him. I just want him to stop messing with my stuff.
Do you think the relative is doing this for a specific reason that isn't obvious, or do you believe his actions are random and without purpose?

I just said I don't know. 

I can't read his mind. I'm not in his head to know if there's some secret reason. I just... I just know what's happening in my house. That's all.
Do you believe the relative's actions are part of a larger plan that most people wouldn't understand, or do you think they're just random occurrences that bother you?

I don't know about any plans. It's not random, because it's my stuff he's messing with, but... I don't know anything about a larger plan. 

You keep asking me the same kind of thing, and I just don't have an answer for you. I only know what I see him doing.
Do you believe the relative is deliberately trying to upset or harm you, or do you think he might be doing these things without meaning to bother you?

I don't see how it could be an accident. 

...My tools don't move themselves. And my fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. Everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining it, but I'm not. I know he came into this house to get at me. 

It's been months now, and... well, it's plain as day he's trying to take over my place. Push me out. So yeah. He means to do it.
Do you believe there's something special or unique about you that makes the relative target you, something that other people might not understand?

No. I don't... I don't know why you'd ask that. 

I'm just a regular guy. I go to work at the shop, I come home. There's nothing special about me. He just wants my house. That's all there is to it. I don't know why you're trying to make it into something else.
Do you believe the relative is being influenced or directed by someone or something else to act against you?

No. It's just him. 

I haven't seen anybody else around. Nobody else is telling him to do it. It's just him wanting my place. I don't know why you keep asking these strange questions.
Do you believe the relative is deliberately trying to upset or harm you, or do you think he might be doing these things without meaning to bother you?

I thought I just answered that. 

Like I said... it's deliberate. I'm not imagining things, no matter what everybody keeps acting like. My wife's relative is doing it on purpose to get at me. Messing with my tools, ruining my fishing trips... he wants to push me out and take my house. I don't know how many times or ways I have to say it.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed something that others around you don’t seem to notice, like voices, images, or other sensations?

No. No, I don't hear voices. I don't see things that aren't there. 

I'm not crazy. I just... I know what he's doing. That's all. I don't know why we have to keep going over this. I don't hear anything.
Do you think the relative is using any unusual or special methods, like hidden devices or something others might not believe, to interfere with your things?
No. Just... normal things. I don't know anything about hidden devices. He just comes over and messes with my stuff when I'm not looking. That's it.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others might find strange or unbelievable, even if they aren’t related to your relative messing with your things?

No. ...I don't have strange thoughts. 

I just go to work and come home. There's nothing else. I don't know what you're looking for here.
Do you think the relative’s actions are part of a hidden, organized effort to drive you out, or do you believe they are just separate instances of him bothering you?

No. I don't think it's... organized. 

It's just him. He just... does it. I don't know why you're trying to make it sound like some big plot. He's just bothering me.
Do you believe the relative’s actions are getting worse over time or leading to a specific outcome, like forcing you to leave your home completely?

No. It's... about the same. 

I'm not leaving. It's my house. He just keeps messing with my things, that's all. I don't know about any specific outcome.
Even though others have told you that they don't see evidence of the relative's interference, do you still believe without a doubt that he is coming into your house and trying to push you out?

Yeah. I know what I know. 

People can say whatever they want. They're not the ones living here. I'm here because... everyone acts like I'm making it up. But my tools don't just move on their own. And my fishing trips... every weekend, something gets messed up. It's not an accident. 

It's been going on for months. It's plain as day to me. He's coming in here. He wants my place. He's trying to push me out. I don't care if nobody else sees it. I see it.
